episodes.synopsis: Before the U.A. students head to their training camp, Class 1-A goes to the pool for extra training, and the League of Villains plots their next move.
episodes.title: Game Start

episodes.synopsis: Class 1-A faces the first challenge of their summer training camp when they have to fight their way through “The Beast’s Forest” before lunch.
episodes.title: Wild, Wild Pussycats

episodes.synopsis: Izuku tries to talk with Kota as the first-years start their training in earnest. Little do they know what awaits them in the forest.
episodes.title: Kota

episodes.synopsis: The villains launch their attack, and only Izuku knows where Kota is. Can he get to him in time?
episodes.title: My Hero

episodes.synopsis: Izuku finally makes it back to the training camp only to leave again with a message for Mandalay to broadcast.
episodes.title: Drive It Home, Iron Fist!!!

episodes.synopsis: The students and teachers of U.A. are still fighting in the woods, but has the Vanguard Action Squad accomplished its mission already…?!
episodes.title: Roaring Upheaval

episodes.synopsis: The battle at the training camp concludes, and now the students and teachers of U.A. have to deal with the aftermath.
episodes.title: What a Twist!

episodes.synopsis: Todoroki, Kirishima, and Midoriya want to go after Bakugo, but the class rep is standing in their way. Meanwhile, Shigaraki makes Bakugo an offer…
episodes.title: From Iida to Midoriya

episodes.synopsis: The heroes and U.A. students close in on the League of Villains’ hideouts, but the League still has an ace up its sleeve.
episodes.title: All For One

episodes.synopsis: As the fight against the League of Villains escalates, can the U.A. students get Bakugo out in time for All Might to make a big comeback?
episodes.title: Symbol of Peace

episodes.synopsis: All Might’s time is running out as he faces his ultimate nemesis head on. Will he finally be able to defeat All For One once and for all?
episodes.title: One For All

episodes.synopsis: After All Might and All For One’s fight, the students go back home while the U.A. teachers decide how to deal with the aftermath.
episodes.title: End of the Beginning, Beginning of the End

episodes.synopsis: The students of Class 1-A move into their dorms and hold a competition to determine who has the best room.
episodes.title: Moving into Dorms

episodes.synopsis: Class 1-A works on developing their Quirks and creating ultimate moves to prepare for the provisional hero licensing exam.
episodes.title: Create Those Ultimate Moves

episodes.synopsis: Izuku and his classmates make some final adjustments to their ultimate moves and then head off to the provisional licensing exam.
episodes.title: The Test

episodes.synopsis: The exam has begun, and everyone’s after Class 1-A! Can the first-years last long enough to pass this first test?
episodes.title: Shiketsu High Lurking

episodes.synopsis: Todoroki’s on his own against Seijin High, and Yaoyorozu’s group is pitted against Seiai Academy as they and the rest of Class 1-A fight to pass the first test.
episodes.title: Class 1-A

episodes.synopsis: It’s down to the final minutes of the first test and almost half of Class 1-A has yet to earn a passing score!
episodes.title: RUSH!

episodes.synopsis: The second test of the provisional licensing has begun, and the hero candidates are suddenly thrust into a rescue operation.
episodes.title: Rescue Exercises

episodes.synopsis: We take a break from the provisional licensing exam to visit a class held before the summer training camp!
episodes.title: Special Episode: Save the World with Love!

episodes.synopsis: The exam nears its end, but Izuku and the other hero candidates must fend off Gang Orca to finish the rescue mission.
episodes.title: What’s the Big Idea?

episodes.synopsis: While the U.A. students finish up the provisional licensing exam and get their results, All Might has a talk with All For One.
episodes.title: A Talk about Your Quirk

episodes.synopsis: Following the provisional licensing exam, Izuku tries out his Shoot Style on Bakugo as they have a heart-to-heart through their fight.
episodes.title: Deku vs. Kacchan, Part 2

episodes.synopsis: The world has changed for villains and heroes alike in the weeks after All Might’s fight with All For One, and the U.A. students start their second semester.
episodes.title: A Season for Encounters

episodes.synopsis: The students of Class 1-A learn about work studies from the Big Three. Meanwhile, the villains also prepare their next steps.
episodes.title: Unrivaled
